description: This file defines the 'Stock' controller class for the admin task report module in the OpenCart project. It primarily contains an 'index' method that loads language settings, models, updates product statistics related to stock quantities, and returns a success message.

classes.name: Stock
classes.description: Controller class responsible for generating stock reports in the admin panel, updating product stock statistics.
